title: Pascal, Cayley and Fermat Contests (PCF)
organization: Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC), University of Waterloo
description: Three linked multiple-choice mathematics contests administered on the same contest day, differentiated by target grade level: Pascal (Grade 9 and below), Cayley (Grade 10 and below), and Fermat (Grade 11 and below). 25 questions, 60 minutes, scored out of 150; available on paper or online per school choice.
cost: CAD $6.00 per participant, plus a $5.00 processing fee per order and shipping
application_requirements: school registration via a contest supervisor
current_cycle_label: 2027 sitting (next scheduled edition as of Aug 2026): North/South America Feb 23-24, 2027; elsewhere Feb 24-25, 2027
verification_status: Verified - official page fetched and read
research_notes: The task named 'Cayley' and 'Fermat' individually, but CEMC administers Pascal/Cayley/Fermat as one combined contest event (same day, one order/registration, split only by grade-targeted difficulty within the same paper) — recorded as a single row rather than three near-identical rows to avoid manufacturing near-duplicates in ORYN's catalogue; Pascal (not named in the task) is included since it is inseparable from the same contest event. Registration deadline varies by region: India Jan 27 2027, other non-Canada/India schools Feb 2 2027, Canadian schools Feb 9 2027 — the Canadian deadline is used as the primary `deadline` field since ORYN's current gap is Canada-specific.

Every Canadian secondary school may nominate one graduating student per year (Quebec CEGEPs may nominate up to four).
application_requirements: school nomination (one student per high school; up to four per Quebec CEGEP)
online application
demonstrated academic excellence and leadership/entrepreneurial mindset
selectivity_evidence: 100 scholarships awarded nationally per year, sourced from one nomination per Canadian high school (thousands of schools); official site describes it as 'Canada's most coveted undergraduate STEM scholarships.'
current_cycle_label: 2027 entry cycle: nomination deadline Jan 27, 2027; student application deadline Feb 17, 2027; university decisions Mar 8-Jun 15, 2027
verification_status: Verified - official page fetched and read

title: Canada-Wide Science Fair (CWSF)
description: Canada's largest annual youth STEM event: nearly 400 finalists in grades 7-12/CEGEP qualify each year by placing at one of over 100 affiliated regional STEM fairs across every Canadian province and territory, then compete nationally for close to CAD $2 million in prizes, scholarships, and opportunities.
application_requirements: win or place at an affiliated regional STEM fair (no direct national application)
selectivity_evidence: Roughly 400 national finalists are selected out of an estimated 25,000 regional-fair competitors annually, per official Youth Science Canada materials.

title: Loran Award
description: A four-year, values-based undergraduate award (CAD $100,000 total: annual stipends, matching tuition waiver, and summer internship funding) for Canadian graduating high school or CEGEP students, selected primarily for character, service, and leadership potential rather than grades alone. Up to 36 Loran Scholars are named annually after a multi-stage selection process.
citizenship_restrictions: Canadian citizenship or permanent resident status required
application_requirements: minimum 88% cumulative average (high school) or R-score >= 29 (CEGEP)
entering university for the first time in September 2027
born between Jan 1, 2005 and Sept 1, 2011 (high school applicants) or Sept 1, 2010 (CEGEP applicants)
multi-stage interviews (semi-final, then national finalist interviews in Toronto)
selectivity_evidence: Up to 36 scholars selected nationally per year; official page describes a funnel of roughly 250 semi-finalists interviewed, narrowing to up to 70 provincial/territorial awards and 90 national finalists.
current_cycle_label: Cycle for students entering university September 2027 — official site shows applications as closed as of research date 2026-08-21; specific closing date is not stated on the fetched page
verification_status: Verified - official page fetched and read
